title: Whip
description: A highly dynamic, physics-based 3D whip mod! Features smooth Verlet integration, satisfying charge attacks, dynamic range scaling, and a Grappling Hook enchantment to swing across the world.
body:
# Whip - Strike, Swing, and Conquer!

Have you ever wanted a weapon that feels truly alive? **Whip** adds a beautifully animated, dynamic whip to your Minecraft arsenal! Whether you want to quickly slash enemies away or charge up for a devastating overhead strike, this whip reacts smoothly to your every move.

### ✨ Features:
*   **Satisfying Combat:** Left-click for a fast, sweeping horizontal slash. Need more power? Hold Right-click to charge up a massive overhead crack that deals heavy damage!
*   **Grappling Hook:** Enchant your whip with **Grapple**, aim at a block, and release your charge to pull yourself through the air! Swing across ravines, climb mountains, and escape danger like a true adventurer.
*   **Dynamic Reach:** The **Reach** enchantment doesn't just increase your hidden stats—it *physically* extends the length of your whip! Watch your whip grow longer and deadlier as you upgrade it up to Level 3.
*   **Immersive Animations:** The whip naturally curls, bends, and reacts to the environment around you. No stiff textures here!

Grab your whip, enchant it, and start swinging across your world today!
